doc:
### PROPOSAL-11 — Glassmorphism Frosted - **slug**: `glassmorphism` - **Vibe**: Frosted translucent glass layers floating over a rich indigo-to-violet depth — airy, light, and softly luminous. - **Best for**: Onboarding and the posting calendar — surfaces that feel weightless over a colorful backdrop. Adjectives: airy, modern, luminous. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`; surface tokens are translucent and must render over a rich indigo-to-violet gradient canvas; all glass surfaces apply `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#191037` | Rich indigo-violet depth (gradient base) | | `--bg-surface` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` | Frosted glass panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)` | Raised glass, modals, hover | | `--border-subtle` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10)` | Hairline frost separators | | `--border-default` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)` | Standard glass borders | | `--border-focus` | `#b7c4ff` | Soft indigo focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#ffffff` | High-contrast headings on glass | | `--text-secondary` | `#e2e0f5` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#a8a3cf` | Captions, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#5747e0` | Deep indigo-violet primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#4637cc` | Action hover (deeper violet) | | `--color-earnings` | `#6ee7b7` | Soft mint earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#4fd1a0` | Earnings hover (deeper mint) | | `--color-automation` | `#93c5fd` | Soft sky automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#fcd34d` | Soft amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#f87171` | Soft red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(87, 71, 224, 0.25)` | Violet aura behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.20)` | Mint aura behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.20)` | Sky aura behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Sora", "Outfit", sans-serif` at 600-700 — airy, geometric, open. Sans: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps and IDs. Numerals `tabular-nums`; generous line-height (1.6 body). - **Radii & Borders**: Large and soft — cards 20-24px, buttons pill, inputs 14px. Borders are 1px translucent white; glass panels add an inset 1px top highlight (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.20)`). No hard shadows — soft 40px ambient shadows only. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Frosted glass pills (translucent fill + blur), 1px translucent border, soft white text; hover raises fill opacity to `0.16`. Primary = violet-tinted glass with bold white text (AA-large, bold 14px+); secondary = neutral glass. Focus = 2px soft indigo ring with a gap. - **Cards**: Translucent frosted panels with `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`, 1px `rgba(255,255,255,0.18)` border, and the inset top highlight. They float over the gradient depth in staggered layers; modal dialogs use `--bg-surface-elevated`. - **Badges/Status**: Glass pills with a tinted glowing dot; publishing = softly breathing mint dot; failed = soft red pill. All fills translucent. - **Tables**: One glass panel with `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` row separators; header in soft caps. Row hover = `--bg-surface-elevated` tint. - **Forms/Inputs**: Glass fields (translucent fill + blur); focus = soft indigo border plus a gentle glow. Labels sit above in muted white. - **Loading**: Three floating glass orbs pulsing in sequence; determinate = a glass track with a white fill bar. - **Signature detail**: The frosted blur itself — translucent layers with `backdrop-filter` over the indigo-violet depth. If the backdrop is flat, the effect dies; the canvas must keep a colorful gradient. - **Motion & Animation**: Airy and weightless — 250-350ms `ease-out`; elements float in with a 10px upward drift and `blur(6px) -> blur(0)`. Glass layers shift subtly on hover; no bounce. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
Earnings / 30d $12,480.50 +14.2%
```
